limitations: Tail captured 11 of 12 invocations: all nine control/PBKDF2 traces and two of three Argon2id timings; do not infer CPU from uncaptured responses.
Worker Date.now does not advance during CPU-only work; use native trace cpuTime, not in-Worker wallMs.
Session control measures random-token generation and digest only, excluding D1, account reads, authorization and app startup.
HTTP 200 is not evidence of staying within the Free-tier CPU budget.
No attempt made to weaken KDF parameters or infer all alternative implementations are impossible.
